finding.title: Fix ParentTrackManagementScreen 'Archive (keep history)' — it wipes stage/goal/point config via deleteTrackAndData exactly like 'Delete and wipe history', and ts3_parent_track_archive_test.dart doesn't catch it

evidence.quote: /// Delegates to [TrackDao.deleteTrackAndData] for each track belonging to
/// Soft-delete a track by setting state = 'deleted' and clearing config.

// Simulate exactly what the fixed archive path does:
// set state='archived' without deleting config rows.

final active = await db.trackDao.getActiveTracksForProfile(_kProfileId);
expect(active.any((t) => t.id == trackId), isFalse,

finding.why: A parent long-presses a track and taps 'Archive (keep history)'; the dialog literally asks 'What should happen to your child's completion history?' implying preservation. The real handler calls curriculumActivationServiceProvider.deactivate() -> ActiveCurriculumDao.deactivateByProfile() -> TrackDao.deleteTrackAndData(), whose own doc-comment says it 'clears config' by hard-deleting goals, stage_definitions, daily_plan rows, point_config, curriculum_scope, study_day_config, track_learning_order and the program-enrolment row, then sets state='deleted' — functionally identical to the 'Delete and wipe history' option (purgeHistory), which only additionally hard-deletes the track row and tombstones completions. `grep -rn TrackState.archived lib/` finds zero writers anywhere in production code — the 'archived' state the TS-3 fix was supposed to introduce is dead. None of the tests that claim to guard this catch it: ts3's 'DB unit' test hand-writes state=archived directly instead of calling deactivate()/deactivateByProfile(); its 'widget' test discards the real screen and shows a hand-built AlertDialog with hardcoded 'Archive (keep history)' text, so it always passes regardless of what the production dialog does; and the l1 suite's archive test only checks the track is absent from the *active* list, which is equally true whether state is 'archived' or 'deleted'. Repo-wide search found no other test (active_curriculum_dao_test.dart, track_dao_last_curriculum_guard_test.dart, epic_26_story_26_22_track_management_body_test.dart) asserting config survives a real deactivate() call — one of those files even names deleteTrackAndData's soft-delete '(archive)' in its own test description, i.e. the codebase's own test suite has internalised 'archive = wipe config' as normal, contradicting the UI copy and the TS-3 docstring's stated intent.
finding.recommendation: Product decision required: (a) implement genuine archive semantics — set state=TrackState.archived and skip the config-table deletes in the code path 'archive' actually calls, or (b) if wiping config on archive is intentional, fix the misleading 'Archive (keep history)' / 'your child's completion history' copy to say what really happens and delete the dead TrackState.archived constant. Either way, rewrite ts3_parent_track_archive_test.dart's widget test to drive the real ParentTrackManagementScreen (longPress + tap on the actual widget tree, as parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart already does) and assert on stage_definitions/goal/point_config row survival, not a hand-rolled dialog.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test that longPresses a track on the real ParentTrackManagementScreen, taps the real 'Archive (keep history)' action, and asserts stage_definitions/goals/point_config rows for that track still exist afterward — this test fails on current main and passes only after the fix.
`grep -rn 'TrackState.archived' learning_tracker/lib/` finds at least one write site (currently zero).
ts3_parent_track_archive_test.dart's widget test pumps ParentTrackManagementScreen and interacts with its actual dialog, not a hand-built AlertDialog.
